segments.oily: A few reviewers with oily-prone skin report the product feels greasy or leaves skin shiny, though others say it is not greasy at all and sits well.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry/normal skin says the serum is not drying even after only a few weeks of use.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe sensitive or reactive skin and report no irritation, moisturized and smooth skin, though one reviewer's skin was scorched/burned by a second bottle.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 80s report smoother texture, reduced fine lines and wrinkles, firmer jawline, and fading age/sun spots, calling it effective for aging skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced fine lines, wrinkles and expression lines, firmer skin and a more youthful look after weeks of use; one reviewer says she cannot speak to wrinkles since she does not have any but sees improvement in discoloration instead.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe skin feeling more hydrated, plumper and less dull, with soft and moisturized results reported after daily use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product evens out areas of redness on her skin, reducing the need for concealer.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report the formula is gentle even with retinol and Vitamin C, with no irritation; one reviewer reports the opposite, describing a burn that took two weeks to heal, and another describes a purge period before improvement.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers, mostly mature-skin users, report visible fading or disappearance of age spots, sun spots and dark/brown spots after weeks to months of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the serum cleared her skin and another says acne scar discoloration disappeared, but one reviewer reports breaking out badly after a single use and returning the product.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the serum is not greasy and absorbs without an oily feel, while others report it left their skin greasy, overpowering, or too heavy depending on how the three chambers dispensed.

extraits.titre: Was way thicker and heavier serum than pictured
extraits.texte: From the pictures and ingredient list you would think its a more lightweight combo of serums. Hyaluronic acid, Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Ferulic Acid... all the main ingredients typically come in semi-clear lightweight serums. I use several of those separately so loved the ideas of them all being together in one formulation. But the bottle I received, one of the "serums" that it pumps out was such a heavy-duty thick/white moisturizer it completely overpowered whatever else was in it.. when applied, my skin was so greasy and disgusting I couldn't even cover up the oil with any amount of powder. I tried it for one day and now my skin is all broken out and I NEVER break out. I really wanted to like this. It may make your skin look 20 years younger, which would be fabulous and all, but I can't leave it on my skin long enough to reap the benefits (especially in Florida where you're a grease-ball all summer anyways). Certainly can't wear during the day. And I wouldn't even entertain wearing it overnight with how it clogged my skin all up and broke it out. I'm returning it ASAP.

extraits.titre: Can't use a product that has fragrance
extraits.texte: I got so excited about this product having ingredients that I had been looking to incorporate into my skincare routine, I completely overlooked whether it had fragrance or not. The product didn't break me out at least, and my skin was less oily in the morning probably thanks to the hyaluronic acid combined with my moisturizer, but from the first application I was able to smell the slight fragrance. It isn't bad but strong enough that it feels like I put on perfume. I don't like skincare products with fragrances because I dislike having all these different smells mixing. This is meant to be applied twice a day, but not ideal for me in the morning since it mixes with the actual perfume that I use, and using products with fragrances at night make me wake up with a headache or dizzy.

I have very sensitive skin. A lot of products bother me and it's hard to find the perfect products for my face. This works like a dream. Doesn't irritate my face and leaves it feeling moisturized and smooth.

extraits.titre: I would love to buy this product again
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this Facial serum. The texture is really great. It almost has three different kinds of syrup and one. One's clear, one's white and one is half white. I took a picture of it. It's almost like one of them is a oil and water them as a light moisturizer in one of them a serum together. I can't really tell a difference yet because I have only been using it for a few weeks. It's not drying. I have dry normal skin.

I worked in the beauty industry in my late teens therefore skin care has been a staple in my routine for the last 20+ years. I have used several products over the years to find one that truly improved my skin. THIS. IS. IT! My large pores, which nothing else touched, are barely there. The acne scar discoloration is completely gone. This is the first time in my life I have felt comfortable without full coverage foundation. My fine lines are truly non existent. It is worth every penny!
I used a whole bottle and was happy with it. Then I bought a second bottle and it scorched my skin. It took 2 weeks for it to heal.

This was a very expensive product for me but, well worth the money and will most likely purchase again. The first time I tried it I was aprehensive about how little product came out after pressing the pump button but, it turns out it is just the right amount. Spreads very easily and absorbs quickly enough for my liking. Once dry, it leaves my skin feeling gloriously smooth. I tend towards areas of redness and the product appears to even out my skin tone so well that I am spending less time trying to even the areas out with concealers and foundation. It does an amazing job on my lines above my upper lip. I rarely feel the need to fill them with filler anymore. I enjoy a lovely scent and this product smells great and is not over powerful. The main drawback is not being able to see how much product is in the bottle as it is being used.
